methodology.ownershipModel: AI Data Platform is scored on its evidence, integration, governance, intelligence, operator and platform responsibilities; source-product business engines are not scored as if AI Data Platform should replace them.
methodology.previousBaseline: Independently reconstructed Build 421 state; does not reuse the user's earlier sample percentages.
methodology.evidenceRule: A deployed screen alone is not proof of live external or physical-host completion. HOLD/UNKNOWN evidence remains incomplete.

categories.name: Master command center & operator visibility
categories.rationale: Broad Master Suite, command-center, attention, health and operator surfaces; Build 422 adds lifecycle/DLP visibility.

categories.name: Data collection & intake
categories.rationale: Collection projects, capture, recipes and collection runs are mature; Build 422 does not materially change intake.

categories.name: Data review & approval
categories.rationale: Review, bulk review, approved data and governed publication paths are established.

categories.name: Data quality & validation
categories.rationale: Quality, validation and evidence-before-claims controls are mature.

categories.name: Provenance & lineage
categories.rationale: Traceability, source lineage, receipts and audit trails are extensive.

categories.name: Search & reporting
categories.rationale: Unified search and reporting are strong; Build 422 adds lifecycle/DLP status to the operating picture.

categories.name: Corrective operations & reconciliation
categories.rationale: Planning, delivery, closure, regression and recurrent-exception workflows are mature.

categories.name: Application registry & module lifecycle
categories.rationale: Application registry, module install/lifecycle/certification and source shells are mature.

categories.name: Cross-application data contracts
categories.rationale: Versioned contracts are mature; Build 422 strengthens classification/retention/export obligations across transfers.

categories.name: Event bus, delivery & replay
categories.rationale: Durable delivery, replay, DLQ and authority-preserving envelopes are mature; DLP renewal adds transfer checks.

categories.name: Source onboarding, signer & trust
categories.rationale: Source registry, signer enrollment, trust ledger and owner review are substantial; live peer gaps remain.

categories.name: Connector setup & diagnostics
categories.rationale: Setup, credentials, validation, diagnostics and integration recovery are present.

categories.name: Shared identity & customer resolution
categories.rationale: Cross-app identity resolution exists but remains partly dependent on source applications.

categories.name: Shared scheduling & work queue
categories.rationale: Shared tasks, work queue and scheduling exchange are mature.

categories.name: Tenant/workspace isolation & authorization
categories.rationale: Build 421 renewed least privilege, tenant/workspace isolation, revocation and delegated capability rules.

categories.name: Consent & notification governance
categories.rationale: Build 421 renewed consent lifecycle; Build 422 preserves consent and purpose constraints through retention/export handling.

categories.name: Data classification
categories.rationale: Build 410 provided a foundation; Build 422 adds fresh seven-app classification renewal with fail-closed evidence.

categories.name: Encryption & secret custody
categories.rationale: Build 422 renews transport, at-rest and secret-field protection evidence and requires key material outside source control.

categories.name: Redaction & data minimization
categories.rationale: Build 422 renews structured-log redaction, credential-pattern redaction, audit minimization and raw-secret exclusion.

categories.name: Retention & expiry
categories.rationale: Build 422 adds fresh purpose-bound schedules, expiry enforcement and explicit hold-or-delete handling.

categories.name: Deletion evidence & legal holds
categories.rationale: Build 422 adds deletion workflow evidence, immutable deletion receipts and legal-hold preservation.

categories.name: DLP & export controls
categories.rationale: Build 422 adds export inspection, owner-gated restricted export, secret-reference-only transfer and cross-tenant exfiltration denial.

categories.name: Privileged operations & owner gates
categories.rationale: Privileged operations, break-glass custody and owner-gated consequential actions are mature.

categories.name: Audit & evidence immutability
categories.rationale: Build 422 adds append-only lifecycle/DLP renewal ledgers with FORCE RLS and evidence digests.

categories.name: Incident response, recovery & rollback
categories.rationale: Incident fusion, supervised recovery, rollback readiness and post-recovery checks are strong.

categories.name: Performance & capacity governance
categories.rationale: Performance budgets, forecasts and deployment-usage guardrails are established.

categories.name: Desktop UX & accessibility
categories.rationale: Responsive desktop controls and Build 420 accessibility recertification surfaces are strong.

categories.name: Tablet UX & accessibility
categories.rationale: Responsive tablet support is good, with some operational screens better suited to larger displays.

categories.name: Mobile UX & accessibility
categories.rationale: Mobile support is broad but complex Master workflows remain denser on small screens.

categories.name: Offline/degraded-network resilience
categories.rationale: Build 420 covers degraded-network states, retry and data-preserving recovery.

categories.name: Theme & design system
categories.rationale: Sixteen shared Master themes and common responsive controls provide strong presentation maturity.

categories.name: Workflow automation & AI suggestions
categories.rationale: Workflow automation, suggestions and supervised action boundaries are extensive.

categories.name: External runtime/original-host evidence
categories.rationale: Software controls exist, but physical Windows service/reboot/witness evidence remains intentionally separate.

categories.name: Cross-application live operational evidence
categories.rationale: Build 422 adds fresh source-owned lifecycle/DLP evidence contracts, while several live peer ceremonies remain HOLD.

categories.name: Release/CI/migration engineering
categories.rationale: Build verifiers, migration gates, exact-SHA production promotion and source-of-truth checks are highly mature.

categories.name: Documentation, help & runbooks
categories.rationale: Build documentation, help, guided runbooks and source-of-truth records are extensive.
